holdout_selection.plan: Score each on 2025+ with the config acceptance rules, then combine both in one account.
holdout_selection.rationale: 15m #7 and 5m #13 picked as a pair for one account: the two strongest single versions on a composite of dev/val Sharpe and PF, beating random entries, local-move and perturbation stability, cost stress and the ES transfer check; 50/50 pair dev Sharpe 1.75, val 1.93, daily correlation ~0.45-0.5. Chosen using development and 2023-2024 data only.

selection_rules.ordering: median stage-4 Sharpe (local_perturbation) desc, profitable dev years desc, dev Sharpe desc, config_id asc
